// why: The library stays JavaScript; its types are the JSDoc already in src/.
`bun run types` emits a declaration beside each source and commits it:
gpui-shell fetches this repository as a Git dependency and runs no build
step in it, so what an application can see is what is checked in. Beside
the sources rather than under a directory of their own because that is
where gpui-shell's editor link looks when a platform refuses a symlink
and it re-exports src/index.js by path. There is no outDir for the same
reason; the script clears the previous emit so tsc does not read its own
typings/gpui.d.ts stands in for the declarations gpui-shell generates
beside a running application, so the emit is the same on any machine.
noImplicitAny is off because a private field assigned only in a builder
has no annotation to read; every public shape is declared in JSDoc.
